battle.name: 越占戰爭 (982年)
battle.theater: 越南中部廣平省博公隘
battle.brief: 太平興國七年，前黎朝皇帝黎桓大舉南征占城，舟師沿海、陸師越嶺，擬直取占城王都毗若。交趾前鋒深入博公隘後，遭占城軍與降將柳繼宗所部反擊，銳卒與糧秣大部陷於嶺道。卡面斯巴達長矛未現於此役，其前鋒列槍互衛、以長矛定勝敗的原理，正是交趾長矛隊在隘口失手之因。

countries: 越占戰爭（982年）是前黎朝皇帝黎桓對南方鄰國占城發動的跨境戰爭，交戰一方是以大越（升龍）為都的前黎朝交趾，另一方是占城國王婆伽婆摩跋摩統治的占城王國。交趾方面，黎桓原為吳朝將領，公元979年乘吳氏內訌奪位建國，中央設內外錦衣衞與朝林宿衞掌管兵權，州鎮仍領鄉兵民兵，全軍分京師禁旅、州郡鄉兵與沿海水軍三層，能水陸並行，但重裝步卒偏少、山嶺行軍吃力。占城方面，王都毗若（後世稱歸仁）為分邦式城國聯盟，國王兼掌祭祀與軍令，以象兵、象騎、弓弩手和婆羅門出身的精兵為骨幹，海軍巡弋於海岸。占城境內還有交趾叛將柳繼宗所率兵眾，據地自雄，使占城對交趾既是外敵，也是內部不穩的變數。此役因此同時是一場對外戰爭，也是一場對占城內部勢力的較量。
countriesEn: The War of Vietnamese Occupation of Champa (982) was a cross-border war launched by Lê Hoàn, emperor of the Early Lê dynasty, against his southern neighbour Champa. One side was the Đại Cồ Việt state of the Early Lê, with its capital at Cổ Lộng (Thăng Long); the other was the kingdom of Champa under King Paramesvaravarman I. On the Vietnamese side, Lê Hoàn had been a general of the Ngô dynasty and seized the throne in 979 amid the Ngô collapse, founding the Early Lê. At the centre, the Inner and Outer Brocade Guards together with the Court and Night Watch units held command of the army, while the provincial centres still commanded their own militia and levies. The Vietnamese army therefore rested on three tiers: palace troops, provincial levies, and a coastal navy able to move by water and land at once, though it was short of heavy infantry and was awkward in the mountains. On the Champa side, Vijaya (later known as Quy Nhơn) was a federation of city-states; the king combined religious and military authority, and the army rested on war elephants, mounted and dismounted elephant troops, crossbowmen and Brahman-born elite infantry, with a fleet patrolling the coast. Inside Champa also stood the following of Lưu Kế Tông, a Vietnamese defector who had made himself a power in his own right, so that Champa was at once a foreign enemy of Đại Cồ Việt and a source of internal instability. The war was therefore at the same time a campaign against a foreign state and a struggle over the politics inside the enemy's own camp.
people: 關鍵人物集中在三方。前黎朝皇帝黎桓是此役的推手：他原是吳朝重臣，公元979年吳氏內訌、吳日福敗亡之後以兵諫奪位，其後平定內亂，又於981年擊退北方宋軍的進攻，聲勢正盛，卻在982年把主力推向南方。他並非好戰之君，此番用兵，一半是為拔除盤踞占城的交趾叛將柳繼宗，一半是要把國勢轉化為外征的聲望。占城國王婆伽婆摩跋摩自960年在位，982年已是他統治的末年，據守王都毗若，倚靠象兵與山隘抵擋。柳繼宗原為交趾將領，後投占城，981年前後在占城奪得實權，拒絕交趾來使，982年更率所部與占城軍合擊越軍，成為扭轉戰局的關鍵人物。吳日福等吳朝餘部在979年曾藉占城之師企圖復國，卻遇颱風毀船而告吹，說明交趾與占城的恩怨早於此役；而981年北方宋軍的失敗，則替黎桓解除了後顧之憂，使他得以傾師南下。
peopleEn: Three sets of decisive figures converge here. Lê Hoàn, founder-emperor of the Early Lê, was the driving force. He had been a leading general of the Ngô dynasty and took the throne by armed remonstration in 979, after the internal collapse of the Ngô house and the defeat of Ngô Nhật Khánh; he then suppressed internal rebellions and in 981 beat back a northern invasion by the Song. His position was at its strongest when, in 982, he committed his main army to the south. He was not a warlike ruler by nature, and this campaign served two purposes: partly to root out Lưu Kế Tông, the Vietnamese renegade entrenched in Champa, and partly to convert the momentum of his new reign into prestige abroad. Paramesvaravarman I of Champa, who had reigned since 960, was in the final year of his rule in 982; he held Vijaya and relied on his elephants and his mountain passes to hold the line. Lưu Kế Tông, once an officer of Đại Cồ Việt who had fled to Champa, seized the real power there around 981 and refused to receive envoys from the Vietnamese court; in 982 his troops fought alongside the Cham and were the decisive factor in turning the battle. Ngô Nhật Khánh and the other Ngô remnants had earlier tried in 979 to recover their country through a Champa-backed expedition, which was wrecked by a typhoon, showing that the quarrel between Đại Cồ Việt and Champa long predated this war; and the failure of the northern Song invasion in 981 removed Lê Hoàn's rear anxiety, allowing him to march his army south in full.
kits: 交趾出兵的骨幹裝備是長柄矛與槊，臨時抽調的鄉兵多持木杆加刃的樗矛，配圓盾或皮牌；禁旅與前鋒用鎧甲、兜鍪與勁弩，大弩、臂弩是越軍在山林與隘道中壓制對方仰射的主要手段，弓、環首刀與標槊為輔。占城方面以象為重：衝鋒象、象騎與披甲象兵在土路與丘陵中作前鋒，弓弩手與婆羅門精兵在後列陣，毒標、毒箭與短鏃是占城軍的特色，海上則有平底沙船與走舸。糧秣以稻米、鹽、柴炭為主，須由海路與嶺道同時輸送。卡面斯巴達長矛並未出現於此役，它的兩米槍身與銅套槍尾屬希臘城邦的工藝，與東亞的槊、樗矛並不同源；但它所代表的戰法，即前鋒以長矛列線、彼此互衛、令對手騎兵與象兵不得直衝而回，正對應交趾前鋒在博公隘所犯的規矩——槍線一旦被象踐與亂軍切斷，密集的矛手便立刻失去互相掩護的力量。
kitsEn: The core of the Vietnamese equipment was the long spear and the sơn, and hastily raised levies carried shafted polearms with a blade lashed to the tip, paired with round shields or leather-faced boards; the palace troops and the vanguard used armour, helmets and heavy crossbows, and the great crossbow and the arming bow were the principal means by which the Vietnamese suppressed enemy fire from the slopes and passes, with bows, ring-pommel sabres and javelins in support. Champa put its weight on the elephant: charging elephants, mounted elephant troops and armoured elephant infantry led the advance over tracks and hills, while crossbowmen and Brahman elite infantry formed up in the rear; poisoned javelins, poisoned arrows and short barbs were a Cham speciality, and at sea they used flat-bottomed sand ships and swift galleys. Supplies consisted mainly of rice, salt and fuel, and had to be carried both by sea and along the mountain track. The spartan spear on the card never appeared in this war: its two-metre shaft and bronze-shod butt belong to the craft of the Greek city-states and are not of the same lineage as the sơn or the sharpened polearm of East Asia. Yet the tactical idea it stands for is exact. The vanguard lines up spears, shields the spears mutually, and stops the enemy's horse and elephant from charging straight in; that is precisely the rule the Vietnamese vanguard broke at Bô Cô. Once the spear line was trampled by elephants and cut by routed men, the closely packed spearmen instantly lost the mutual cover that had held them together.
tactics: 此役的部署是一場典型的水陸兩用跨境進攻。黎桓以舟師沿海北上，以陸師自大越中部越嶺南下，兩路指向占城王都毗若，意在由海路輸送糧秣與援兵，由陸路攻取山隘。占城方面據隘而守，把戰場設在嶺南通道最窄的博公一帶，使越軍必須逐段展開，無法把多餘兵力同時投入。黎桓的失誤，在於把柳繼宗視為可誅的內患，而不是一個正在運作的中樞：占城已得其求援與行軍情報，先以小股兵力誘越軍前鋒深入，再以象兵正面掩護，令柳繼宗所部由側後插入，切斷隘口與後方之間的聯絡。越軍糧道在山道中被斷，部隊被切成數段，前鋒即使握有長矛與勁弩，失去縱深與掩體之後亦難以結陣；退路一旦被占城騎兵與象兵封住，狹隘地形便成了吞噬越軍的爐膛。占城軍隨後佔領越軍遺棄的營地、糧秣與器械，一路追擊至嶺道深處。此役並無攻城戰，勝負全在野外的隘道會戰中決定。
tacticsEn: The deployment was a classic amphibious cross-border attack. Lê Hoàn sent a fleet along the coast and an army over the central mountains of Đại Cồ Việt, both aimed at the Cham capital of Vijaya, the fleet to carry grain and reinforcements and the land column to take the passes. Champa fought from its passes and chose the narrowest section of the corridor south of the mountains, at Bô Cô, so that the Vietnamese could only deploy in dribs and drabs and could never commit their reserves. Lê Hoàn's fatal error was to treat Lưu Kế Tông as a domestic traitor to be exterminated rather than as a working centre of power: Champa had already received his appeals for help and news of the march, and so brought forward small bodies to draw the Vietnamese vanguard deep into the pass, covered the counter-stroke with elephants in front, and sent Lưu Kế Tông's men in from the flank and rear to cut the pass off from the rear areas. The Vietnamese supply line was severed on the track, the army was cut into several segments, and the vanguard, even with long spears and heavy crossbows, could no longer form up once it had lost depth and cover; when the retreat was closed by Cham cavalry and elephants, the narrow defile became a furnace that swallowed the column. The Cham then took the abandoned camp, grain and weapons and pursued the survivors deep into the mountains. There was no siege in this war at all: the whole thing was decided in a field engagement in the passes.
data: 可核的數字有限，但時序相當明確。交趾此役記於天成四年、宋太宗太平興國七年，即公元982年，兵出於秋季。相關紀年可作骨架：979年占城水師在海上遇颱風，舟師多毀；同年交趾吳氏餘部曾企圖藉占城之力復國而告吹；980年黎桓遣使赴占城，使者被拘留；981年前後柳繼宗在占城奪權並拒絕交趾干涉，同年交趾擊退北方宋軍的進攻；982年越軍大舉南征；其後柳繼宗於983年篡占城王位，986至989年間在位，這組年份在《欽定越史通鑑綱目》與後世史家處略有出入。兵員方面，越方編年與後世記載常以「十萬」或「數十萬」形容此役出師，數字明顯有誇大之處，較可確認的只是此役傾注了交趾可調集的絕大部分兵力，遠超此前任何一次跨境用兵。損失方面，越軍大敗於博公，士卒、象兵、器械與儲糧大部陷於嶺道，生還者數量史無明文，只有「損失過半」一類的概括；占城守住了王都，但北方村邑與稻田在往後數年的兵禍中遭到焚掠。875至982年原本是學界公認的占城藝術黃金時代，而982年恰為其下限。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, but the sequence of events is clear. The campaign is dated in the Vietnamese Tiancheng era year four and in the Song Taipingxingguo year seven, that is 982, with the army setting out in the autumn. The surrounding chronology can serve as a skeleton: in 979 a typhoon destroyed much of the Cham fleet at sea, and in the same year Ngô Nhật Khánh's attempt to recover his country with Champa's help came to nothing; in 980 Lê Hoàn sent an embassy to Champa and the envoys were detained; around 981 Lưu Kế Tông seized power in Champa and refused to let Đại Cồ Việt interfere, and in the same year the Vietnamese beat back a northern Song invasion; in 982 the great southern expedition was launched; afterwards Lưu Kế Tông seized the Cham throne in 983 and reigned from 986 to 989, though these dates vary slightly between the Quỳnh Tuệ Việt sử thông giám cương mục and later historians. On numbers of men, the Vietnamese annals and later writers habitually describe the army as tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands, which is plainly exaggerated; what can be said with confidence is only that the campaign concentrated almost the whole of the forces Đại Cồ Việt could raise, far beyond anything spent on a border crossing before. On losses, the Vietnamese were beaten at Bô Cô and men, elephants, weapons and stored grain were left in the passes; the number of survivors is nowhere recorded, only generalities about more than half being lost. Champa kept its capital, but the villages and paddy fields of the northern zone were burned and plundered in the wars of the years that followed. The period 875 to 982 is the golden age of Cham art in the consensus of scholarship, and 982 is precisely its end.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。其一是外交挫敗：980年黎桓遣使赴占城，使者卻被占城王拘留，使節被扣在傳統上等同於受辱，黎桓必須有所回應。其二是通道與生計：占城扼住嶺南通道與南海航路，截斷交趾向南的商路、逃戶與船貨，越人南遷與貿易的血管自10世紀起便被占城握在手裡。其三是安全：占城收留交趾叛將吳日福、柳繼宗等越人，用以扶植傀儡、牽制交趾，黎桓不能容忍一個以越人為主體的反叛政權立在國門之外。其四是內政：新朝初立，州鎮割據與叛亂未平，黎桓需要一場對外勝利來鞏固新朝權威，把國內的不滿轉向南方。值得注意的是，四層原因都指向同一種思維：把占城視為可一舉消滅的軟弱目標，於是把大軍傾巢而出。
causeEn: Four layers of cause lie behind the war. The first is diplomatic humiliation: in 980 Lê Hoàn sent an embassy to Champa and the envoys were detained by the Cham king, and in traditional reckoning the arrest of envoys is an insult that must be answered. The second is the corridor and the livelihood: Champa held the passes south of the mountains and the sea lanes, and could cut the trade, the runaway population and the cargo flowing south from Đại Cồ Việt; the vein of southward migration and commerce had been in Cham hands since the tenth century. The third is security: Champa harboured Vietnamese defectors such as Ngô Nhật Khánh and Lưu Kế Tông to plant clients and tie down the Vietnamese court, and Lê Hoàn could not tolerate a regime ruled largely by Vietnamese rebels standing at his frontier. The fourth is domestic politics: the new dynasty was young, the provincial centres were still restive, and Lê Hoàn needed an external victory to shore up the authority of the Early Lê and to turn the discontent at home towards the south. All four lines of reasoning point the same way: Champa was treated as a soft target that could be disposed of in one stroke, and the whole army was thrown at it on that assumption.
impact: 982年的敗仗是交趾與占城四百餘年衝突史上的轉折點，而受損最重的其實是占城。越軍雖被擊退，戰爭卻打開了缺口：柳繼宗於983年篡占城王位後，北方占城陷入長達數年的內戰與屠殺，村莊、寺廟與石刻造像被大量毀壞，學界原本劃定的875至982年占城藝術黃金時代就此畫上句號，婆羅門傳統與地方信仰在北方的崩解遠早於南部。對交趾而言，出征失利意味著它在北方的優勢被抹平：981年剛擊退宋軍，939年建國以來的獨立局面並未受損，但黎桓自此再無力向北，也無法解決占城內部被自己人占據的問題，此後數十年交趾對外的主動權轉移到北方與海上。兵器史上的教訓更直接：長矛線在隘口被象兵正面犁開、又被側翼插入切斷之後，集結的白刃兵器再精良也救不回陣線；越人此後再南征時改以水軍為主、避免深入嶺道，這一轉向在此後百餘年的南進中一直延續。
impactEn: The defeat of 982 was a turning point in the more than four centuries of conflict between Đại Cồ Việt and Champa, and the party that suffered most in the long run was Champa itself. The Vietnamese were beaten back, yet the war opened a breach: after Lưu Kế Tông seized the Cham throne in 983, northern Champa fell into years of civil war and slaughter, with villages, temples and stone images destroyed on a large scale, and the golden age of Cham art, which scholarship had fixed at 875 to 982, came to an end. The collapse of the Brahman tradition and of local religion in the north long preceded anything comparable in the south. For Đại Cồ Việt the failed expedition meant that its northern advantage was wiped away: it had beaten the Song only in 981, and the independence won in 939 was not imperilled, but from then on Lê Hoàn could no longer project power north, nor could he settle the problem of a Cham throne held by one of his own defectors; for several decades afterwards Vietnamese initiative in foreign affairs swung north and seaward. The lesson in the history of weapons is more direct still: once the spear line has been ploughed open by elephants from the front and cut by an insertion from the flank, no amount of fine close-combat steel can restore the formation. Thereafter, when the Vietnamese campaigned south again, they leaned on their fleet and avoided pushing deep into the mountain tracks, and that turn persisted through more than a century of southern advance.
result: 結果是交趾的南征徹底失敗。越軍在博公隘被占城軍與柳繼宗所部擊潰，前鋒與大批隨軍人員戰死或被俘，糧秣、器械與軍象盡棄於嶺道，黎桓只收得殘部退回境內；占城王都毗若未遭進攻，婆伽婆摩跋摩的統治得以延續，占城也擋下了自10世紀起第一次大規模的反攻。但占城並未因此得救：柳繼宗接掌王位後把占城變成反攻交趾的基地，983至989年間北方城邑屢遭焚掠，王權與佛教秩序漸漸瓦解，十二世紀以後只剩南部殘存的政體，1471年越軍攻陷王都毗若，占城王國才真正走到終點。對交趾而言，982年是一場以傾國之力換來的慘敗；黎桓其後把重心轉回內政，整治州郡、頒布政令、修造佛寺並編纂史書，時間上正是下一個王朝整理南方殘局的起點。
resultEn: The result was the complete failure of the southern expedition. The Vietnamese army was shattered at the pass of Bô Cô by the Cham forces together with those of Lưu Kế Tông; the vanguard and a great part of the following were killed or taken prisoner, and grain, weapons and the war elephants were abandoned in the passes, so that Lê Hoàn could only gather the remnants and withdraw across the frontier. The Cham capital of Vijaya was never attacked, the rule of Paramesvaravarman I continued, and Champa had turned back the first large-scale counter-offensive it had faced since the tenth century. But Champa was not saved by this. Under Lưu Kế Tông it became a base for counter-attacks on Đại Cồ Việt, and between 983 and 989 the northern towns were repeatedly burned and plundered, the royal authority and the Buddhist order decaying by degrees; after the twelfth century only a remnant polity in the south remained, and it was in 1471 that the Vietnamese captured Vijaya and the kingdom of Champa truly reached its end. For Đại Cồ Việt, 982 was a defeat bought with the whole strength of the state; Lê Hoàn afterwards turned his attention back to the interior, reorganising the provinces, issuing ordinances, building temples and compiling the historical record, which in time was the starting point for the next dynasty to settle the southern question.
